stem: Which statement describes how the passage of the Kansas-Nebraska Act of 1854 increased sectionalism?

options.label: A
options.text: It allowed slavery to expand into the territories.

options.label: B
options.text: It gave tax cuts to manufacturers who relocated to the territories.

options.label: C
options.text: It allowed slaves who escaped to the territories to purchase their freedom.

options.label: D
options.text: It granted homesteads to immigrants who settled in the territories.
